Strings.proxy.title: Proxy Manager
Strings.proxy.login_required: Sign in to a RelaxKonOS Server to manage its proxy.
Strings.proxy.status.recovery_required: Network recovery is required before another TUN action.
Strings.proxy.status.operation_queued: The operation was queued on the RelaxKonOS.Server.
Strings.proxy.status.operation_unavailable: The Server operation status is unavailable.
Strings.proxy.subtitle: Manage the host proxy runtime, profiles, traffic and network safety.
Strings.proxy.subscriptions_hint: Subscription configurations are presented as cards; only protected runtime metadata is shown.
Strings.proxy.subscription_runtime_required: Install the managed Mihomo runtime before importing a subscription so its configuration can be validated.
Strings.proxy.subscription_system_proxy.title: Download subscription through system proxy
Strings.proxy.subscription_system_proxy.message: RelaxKonOS Server has a system proxy configured. Use it to download this subscription? Choosing Cancel connects directly to the subscription source.
Strings.proxy.status.runtime_subscriptions_shown: Showing subscriptions active in the runtime.
Strings.proxy.status.subscription_none: There is no active runtime subscription to view.
Strings.proxy.routing_mode_hint: Choose how Mihomo routes new connections.
Strings.proxy.traffic_statistics_hint: Live counters reported by Mihomo when the controller is available.
Strings.proxy.latency_test_selected: Test this group's selected proxy latency
Strings.proxy.latency_test_all: Test all proxy latencies in this group
Strings.proxy.latency_test_target_placeholder: Enter a URL to use for the latency test
Strings.proxy.quick_actions_hint: Lifecycle requests run on the Server and report a durable operation ID.
Strings.proxy.runtime_control_hint: Use the power control to start or stop the managed proxy runtime.
Strings.proxy.network_protection_hint: Active connections are read from the proxy controller without exposing its secret.
Strings.proxy.recovery_required: A recovery marker is active. Restore network connectivity before enabling TUN again.
Strings.proxy.safety_hint: RelaxKonOS keeps controller credentials and raw proxy configuration on the RelaxKonOS.Server. TUN changes are transactional and can be emergency-disabled.
Strings.proxy.profiles_hint: Profiles identify protected proxy configurations stored on the host. Activate one before enabling TUN.
Strings.proxy.proxies_hint: Choose a proxy for a controller-provided selection group.
Strings.proxy.connections_hint: Connections are bounded server-side controller data.
Strings.proxy.logs_hint: Only sanitized, bounded logs are available here.
Strings.proxy.runtime_download_unavailable: No trusted Mihomo package is available for manual download on this platform.
Strings.proxy.runtime_server_file_hint: Choose a Mihomo archive already on the RelaxKonOS Server that matches the trusted current release.
Strings.proxy.geodata.hint: For subscriptions with GEOIP rules, select geoip.metadb already present on the RelaxKonOS RelaxKonOS.Server. It is copied into Mihomo's protected data directory, so subscription validation does not need to download it.
Strings.proxy.status.geodata_configured: A local GeoIP database is configured for Mihomo.
Strings.proxy.proxy_host_follows_listener: The proxy host follows Mihomo's active listener, normally localhost.
Strings.proxy.system_proxy_mode_hint_enabled: System proxy is enabled; host traffic is forwarded through the Mihomo listener.
Strings.proxy.system_proxy_mode_hint_disabled: System proxy is disabled. This option is recommended for most users.
Strings.proxy.tun_mode_hint: TUN mode is disabled. Use it for applications that require traffic interception.
Strings.proxy.tun_managed_settings_hint: RelaxKonOS manages the virtual adapter transactionally on the Server, validating the active profile and management route before enabling it.
Strings.proxy.network_settings_hint: Network-changing actions are available only when this host supports them.
Strings.proxy.subscription_insecure_sources_hint: When off, only public HTTPS links with valid certificates are allowed. When on, HTTP and invalid or self-signed HTTPS certificates are also allowed; private, loopback, and link-local addresses remain blocked.
Strings.proxy.port_restart.title: Restart Mihomo to apply the port
Strings.proxy.port_restart.message: The port setting was saved. Mihomo must restart before it listens on the new port. Restart now?
Strings.proxy.status.port_restart_pending: The port setting was saved. Restart Mihomo when convenient for the new port to take effect.
Strings.proxy.operation.copying: Copying the Mihomo package from the Server…
Strings.proxy.status.controller_authentication_f: Mihomo controller authentication failed. Review the server configuration and try again.
Strings.proxy.controller_authentication.title: Mihomo controller rejected the server credential
Strings.proxy.controller_authentication.hint: The controller returned HTTP 401. This is not a RelaxKonOS sign-in failure. First confirm that another Mihomo or Clash instance is not using the loopback controller port configured for RelaxKonOS; if the port is free, verify that the Server and managed controller credentials match.
Strings.proxy.problem.runtime_not_installed: The Mihomo runtime is not installed.
Strings.proxy.problem.runtime_unsupported_platfo: This platform does not support the managed Mihomo runtime.
Strings.proxy.problem.runtime_version_unsupporte: The requested Mihomo version is not supported.
Strings.proxy.problem.runtime_archive_unavailabl: The selected Mihomo package could not be read. Move it to a regular, non-symlink directory that the RelaxKonOS Server service account can access, then try again.
Strings.proxy.problem.runtime_integrity_failed: The Mihomo package did not pass verification. Confirm that its version, architecture, and SHA-256 match the trusted release.
Strings.proxy.problem.runtime_health_check_faile: Mihomo did not pass its health check after the operation.
Strings.proxy.problem.external_runtime_invalid: The configured external Mihomo runtime is invalid.
Strings.proxy.problem.service_unavailable: The managed Mihomo service is unavailable.
Strings.proxy.problem.privileged_operation_unava: This operation requires unavailable server privileges.
Strings.proxy.problem.config_apply_failed: The proxy configuration could not be applied.
Strings.proxy.problem.controller_authentication_: The Mihomo controller rejected the server credential (HTTP 401).
Strings.proxy.problem.controller_response_invali: The Mihomo controller returned an invalid response.
Strings.proxy.problem.controller_timeout: The Mihomo controller did not respond in time.
Strings.proxy.problem.port_in_use: A local port required by Mihomo is already in use. Stop the leftover managed service or free the controller and mixed-proxy ports, then try again.
Strings.proxy.problem.management_route_unsafe: The current management route is unsafe for this network change.
Strings.proxy.problem.platform_capability_unavai: This host does not support the requested proxy capability.
Strings.proxy.problem.tun_permission_required: This TUN operation requires additional permission.
Strings.proxy.problem.tun_activation_failed: TUN activation failed and was rolled back.
Strings.proxy.problem.recovery_required: Network recovery is required before continuing.
Strings.proxy.problem.idempotency_key_required: The Server rejected the request because its operation key was missing.
Strings.proxy.problem.permission_denied: You do not have permission to perform this proxy operation.
Strings.proxy.problem.not_supported: This proxy operation is not supported.
Strings.proxy.problem.subscription_invalid: The subscription link or configuration is invalid.
Strings.proxy.problem.subscription_fetch_failed: The subscription content could not be retrieved.
Strings.proxy.problem.subscription_system_proxy_: The Server system proxy is unavailable or does not apply to this subscription address.
Strings.proxy.problem.geodata_unavailable: The subscription requires GeoIP data, but the Server could not download it. Check DNS/outbound access or use a subscription without GEOIP rules.
Strings.proxy.problem.geodata_invalid: The selected GeoIP database is invalid, too large, or unavailable to the RelaxKonOS Server service account. Select a regular geoip.metadb file accessible on the RelaxKonOS.Server.
Strings.proxy.problem.http_401: Your RelaxKonOS session is no longer authorized. Sign in again.
Strings.proxy.problem.response_empty: The Server returned an empty proxy response.
